name: Banner on a Shield
note: Shield + Banner copies the banner pattern onto the shield.

name: Copy a Banner
note: Banner + identical banner copies the pattern (works for every color).

name: Copy a Written Book
note: Written Book + Book copies every written page.

name: Extend a Map
note: Filled Map + Paper adds one zoom level. The Cartography Table can also extend, lock and copy maps.

name: Fade Firework Star
note: Firework Star + Dye adds a second, fading color to the explosion.

name: Firework Rocket
note: Paper + Gunpowder makes 3 rockets; add a Firework Star for a colored explosion. Extra gunpowder = higher flight.

name: Firework Star
note: Gunpowder + Dye makes a Firework Star. Optional modifiers: Shape (Feather, Creeper Head, Fire Charge or Gold Nugget), Trail (Diamond), Twinkle (Glowstone Dust).

name: Repair & Merge Items
note: Place two damaged tools, weapons or armor of the same kind in the grid (optionally with iron ingots, diamonds or other repair materials) to repair them or merge their enchantments.
